environments.rationale: shared CI is suitable for bounded smoke budgets but too noisy to claim tight relative performance superiority

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process projection of one prevalidated tenant/environment context envelope, measured by a standard-library-only runtime probe that excludes build and process-startup time from the reported per-operation latency.
targets.rationale: The runtime now exists and is verified, so the coarse shared-CI absolute p95 ceiling can execute on PRs that touch the pilot runtime while retaining on-demand execution. Shared CI still makes no relative-performance claim.

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process validation of one prevalidated Event Search tenant/time/source/permission envelope. Registered before implementation; execution remains on-demand and fail-closed until E10-INV-002B provides the runtime handler.
targets.rationale: Preimplementation performance ownership for CAP-INV-002 query validation. The 1 ms bound applies only to deterministic in-process validation, not backend search latency and not a production Search SLO.
